TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_schoolyear
TABLE.COMMENT: A teacher's school year: its dates hold the holidays and evaluation periods shared by all of that teacher's plans in the year.

FIELD.NAME: startdate
FIELD.COMMENT: First day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: Last day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_holiday
TABLE.COMMENT: A holiday (one day or a period) of a school year; owned through the school year.

FIELD.NAME: startdate
FIELD.COMMENT: First day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: Last day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd; equal to startdate for a single day.

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: Text after the dates; empty when there is none.

TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_evaluation
TABLE.COMMENT: An evaluation period of a school year (1a, 2a, 3a avaluació), used to group the export summary.

FIELD.NAME: startdate
FIELD.COMMENT: First day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: Last day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_plan
TABLE.COMMENT: A teacher's year plan for one module, imported from Markdown; read-only once approved.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional course the plan is linked to.

FIELD.NAME: modulecode
FIELD.COMMENT: Module code from the # heading (MP 0372); empty when there is none.

FIELD.NAME: moduletitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Module text from the # heading; empty when there is none.

FIELD.NAME: startdate
FIELD.COMMENT: First class day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd; null until known.

FIELD.NAME: enddate
FIELD.COMMENT: Last class day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd; null until known.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft or approved.

FIELD.NAME: sourcetext
FIELD.COMMENT: The imported Markdown, as pasted or uploaded; null before the first import.

FIELD.NAME: timeapproved
FIELD.COMMENT: When the plan was approved and locked; 0 for a draft.

TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_slot
TABLE.COMMENT: Weekly timetable of a plan: hours of class per weekday.

FIELD.NAME: weekday
FIELD.COMMENT: Monday = 0 to Sunday = 6, as in the calendar class.

INDEX.NAME: planid-weekday
INDEX.COMMENT: One slot per weekday in a plan.

TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_planitem
TABLE.COMMENT: One planned day of a plan (a ### section of the Markdown), frozen when the plan is approved.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Position in the plan text, from 1.

FIELD.NAME: sessiondate
FIELD.COMMENT: Planned day, ISO yyyy-mm-dd, from the plan text.

FIELD.NAME: block
FIELD.COMMENT: The RA or block (## heading) above the day; empty when there is none.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Short title after the date and hours; empty when there is none.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: The day's plan, Markdown; empty for an empty day.

FIELD.NAME: hours
FIELD.COMMENT: Planned hours, from the plan text or the timetable; null when neither gives them.

TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_entry
TABLE.COMMENT: What actually happened in a session: at most one per plan item, any number of unplanned ones. The text may name students.

FIELD.NAME: planitemid
FIELD.COMMENT: The planned day; null for an unplanned session.

FIELD.NAME: sessiondate
FIELD.COMMENT: Day the session took place, ISO yyyy-mm-dd.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Done, partly done or not done; codes fixed in M3.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: What was done.

FIELD.NAME: contentformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Text format of content; 4 is FORMAT_MARKDOWN.

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Reason code for a deviation; empty when there is none.

FIELD.NAME: reasonnote
FIELD.COMMENT: Free text about the reason.

FIELD.NAME: measure
FIELD.COMMENT: Corrective action for a deviation.

FIELD.NAME: carry
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when unfinished content is carried over to a later session.

FIELD.NAME: writtenon
FIELD.COMMENT: Day the entry was written, ISO yyyy-mm-dd in the user's time zone; later than sessiondate means late.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Also the version a form carries to refuse stale saves.

KEY.NAME: planitemid
KEY.COMMENT: One entry per plan item; created as a unique index, which allows any number of nulls.

TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_entry_hist
TABLE.COMMENT: History of every change to an entry, kept after the entry is deleted.

FIELD.NAME: entryid
FIELD.COMMENT: The entry; it may no longer exist.

FIELD.NAME: planid
FIELD.COMMENT: The entry's plan, so the row stays owned after the entry is deleted.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who made the change.

FIELD.NAME: realuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: The real user when the change was made while logged in as userid; null otherwise.

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: create, update or delete.

FIELD.NAME: snapshot
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of every field of the entry after the change (before it, for a delete).

TABLE.NAME: local_classprogress_import
TABLE.COMMENT: Log of plan imports. The text itself is kept on the plan, not here.

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: paste or upload.

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the uploaded file; empty for pasted text.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of the imported text.

FIELD.NAME: daycount
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of days read.
